slides.title: Start with a read-only check
slides.lead: State the target, scope, safety boundary, and output format together.

cards.title: One complete task
cards.code: Perform a read-only health check on the connected RDK X5. Check device and SSH status, CPU, memory, temperature, storage, and network. Do not install software, change configuration, or restart services.
cards.note: Return Healthy, Needs Attention, and Recommended Action, then list every verified item.

cards.title: Explicit safety boundary
cards.code:
Read information only
Do not install software
Do not change configuration
Do not restart services
cards.note: A failed check must be marked unverified, never guessed.

cards.title: Connection
cards.body: Device and SSH are successful, failed, or unverified.

cards.title: CPU
cards.body: Inspect load or utilization.

cards.title: Memory
cards.body: Check total, used, and available memory.

cards.title: Temperature
cards.body: Read the current key temperature.

cards.title: Storage
cards.body: Check the main filesystem and free space.

cards.title: Network
cards.body: Explain interface and connectivity without exposing addresses.

slides.title: Launch BPU YOLO with one prompt
slides.lead: Name the device, compute engine, input, and final result—not the repository or commands.

cards.title: Target and compute
cards.code: On the connected RDK X5, run real-time YOLO object detection using the X5 BPU.
cards.note: Inference must run on the BPU, not the CPU.

cards.title: Input and result
cards.code: Use the USB camera connected to the X5. When ready, open the live detection page in RDK Studio's built-in browser.

slides.title: From one sentence to live video
All six conditions must pass
slides.lead: Logs, a still image, or CPU inference cannot replace the live BPU result.
items: The target is the currently connected RDK X5
YOLO inference runs on the X5 BPU
Input comes from the USB camera connected to the X5
Studio automatically opens its built-in browser
The browser continuously displays the live camera stream
Detection boxes and class labels appear in the live view

slides.title: Six checks before risky actions
slides.lead: Installation, networking, restart, file overwrite, flashing, and external sharing require explicit review.
items: The target path or medium is correct

cards.title: Moss ≠ model
cards.body: Moss manages tasks and tools; the model supplies reasoning.

cards.title: Codex ≠ Studio
cards.body: Codex is an optional external Agent, not the Studio backend.

cards.title: Serial ≠ SSH
cards.body: Serial reads logs; a full workspace needs SSH or supported Type-C.

cards.title: Board Agent is optional
cards.body: Terminal, files, IDE, and normal Moss tasks do not depend on it.
